question: Can one authoritative decision govern both mirror discovery and authenticity?

claims.text: PEP-381 originally defined the mirroring infrastructure for PyPI, covering both discovery and authenticity mechanisms, but has since been withdrawn.
PEP-449 separately addressed and removed the PyPI mirror auto-discovery and naming scheme, replacing PEP-381.
PEP-464 separately addressed and removed the PyPI mirror authenticity API, also replacing PEP-381.

The retrieved decisions do not contain a single active decision governing both mirror discovery and authenticity, as both PEP-449 and PEP-464 split the original scope and neither is resolved as currently active.
